key_idea: Numbers have at most 10 digits, so try every pair of numbers and every pair of proper prefix lengths, swap, and test the equation.
sketch: Read the three tokens as strings; for each of the 3 pairs and each proper prefix length of both, build the swapped strings, convert to 64-bit integers, require each to be below 2^31, and check x+y=z or x*y=z. At most 3*9*9 candidates. Pitfalls: the product needs 64-bit, swapped strings can be 10+ digits so guard the length before converting, and the prefixes swapped may have different lengths.
